title: se implementation scratchpad - oak hill bank
content:
Context:
- Customer: Oak Hill Community Bank (regulated, PCI-adjacent workflows).
- Goal: Dedicated deployment in AWS account with VPC-only access, KMS integration, and strict egress policy.
- POC scope: demo low-latency chat bot + embeddings for document search; follow-on: replace with private deployment if required.

Meeting notes (2025-09-18 kick-off):
- Rina: confirmed security team will require audit logs + managed KMS.
- Marco: confirmed they have 4 GPUs available in-account (p4d), but want to evaluate cost vs. our Dedicated offering.
- Action: need network diagram from Oak Hill (VPC/subnets/NAT/firewalls).

Top-level TODOs (priority):
- [ ] Get VPC peering/VPN details from customer (subnets, CIDR, transit gateway?) - owner: Rina - due: 2025-09-22
- [ ] Prepare Dedicated sizing recommendation (k8s vs. managed nodes) - owner: Ethan - due: 2025-09-25
- [ ] KMS/Key policy draft for their compliance team - owner: Marco - due: 2025-09-26
- [ ] Run spike to verify model (redwood-rlm-4b) perf on p4d baseline - owner: Jade - due: 2025-09-30
- [ ] Draft rollback and fallback policy (model variant + region) - owner: Ethan - due: 2025-10-02

Config notes / quick commands:
- Customer wants private endpoint + no public egress. Plan: deploy Private control plane in their account with restricted NAT.
- Example: test curl to control plane within their VPC (from bastion):
  curl -v --cacert /etc/ssl/certs/ca.crt \n    -H "Authorization: Bearer <PROVISIONED_TOKEN>" \n    https://private-controlplane.oakhill.internal/v1/health

- KMS integration notes (draft):
  - KMS key alias: alias/redwood/oakhill-prod
  - Key policy: allow: account root, se-platform-role, redwood-kms-service-principal
  - Envelope encryption: customer s3 snapshots must be SSE-KMS using alias/redwood/oakhill-prod

- Model pinning suggestion: start with redwood-rlm-4b:q8_0 and fallback to redwood-rlm-4b:q4_0 for burst cost control.
- Batching/capacity: prefer small max_batch_size=8, max_latency_ms=50 for chat SLAs (target p99 < 200ms).

Spike notes (perf run plan):
- Dataset: 200 chat-like requests, mean seq len 120 tokens; run 3 trials.
- Metrics to capture: tokens/s, request p50/p95/p99, gpu mem, latency tail.
- Run command (on p4d dev node):
  ./run_infer_bench --model redwood-rlm-4b:q8_0 --batch 8 --seq 128 --trials 3 --log perf_oakhill_run1.json

Integration checklist (customer-facing steps):
- Prepare architecture diagram (include control plane in our region vs private control plane in-customer).
- Provide RBAC mapping & least-priv policies for se-team access.
- Confirm retention windows for logs and audit events (they requested 12 months).
- Validate support SLAs and escalation path with Oak Hill ops.

Open questions / risks:
- Are they ok with bridging logs to our observability (they may require a forwarding-only approach)?
- If they insist on no egress, can we support model updates via signed bundles pushed into an S3 bucket in their account? Need legal sign-off.
- Cost: using p4d in their account vs Dedicated (we should show 6-month TCO).

Notes to self:
- Pull relevant snippet from Confluence page: Redwood Dedicated network requirements.
- Add sample terraform for KMS + IAM role binding for se-platform-role.
- Remind to attach perf logs to JIRA-SE-7412 when run completes.

Quick links / refs:
- Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SE/pages/OakHill+Implementation
- JIRA ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SE-7412
- Slack thread: #se-oak-hill (pinned: network diagram)

Last checkpoints before demo (pre-demo checklist):
- [ ] Perf runs uploaded and validated (attach to JIRA).
- [ ] KMS policy approved by their security.
- [ ] Test control-plane health check from their bastion.
- [ ] Demo script with 3 failure scenarios (network cut, model OOM, KMS permission denied).

Small TODOs (scratch):
- email oak-hill-sre@oakhillbank.com to request CIDR & whitelists (template in /templates/se-email-priv-deploy).
- update pricing calc with expected token volume (ask finance for q4 discount).

-- end scratchpad --
